import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
raw=np.loadtxt('graphene.dat',delimiter='\t',converters={0:lambda s: float(s.replace(',','.')),1:lambda s: float(s.replace(',','.'))})
x,y=raw[:,0],raw[:,1]; w=1e7/x
o=np.argsort(w); w=w[o]; y=y[o]
def lor(t,x0,g,A,off):

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np, json
from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
raw=np.loadtxt('graphene.dat',delimiter='\t',converters={0:lambda s: float(s.replace(',','.')),1:lambda s: float(s.replace(',','.'))})
x,y=raw[:,0],raw[:,1]
w=1e7/x
o=np.argsort(w); w=w[o]; x=x[o]; y=y[o]

def lor_lin(t,x0,g,A,off,slope):
    return off + slope*(t-x0) + A*(g/2)**2/((t-x0)**2+(g/2)**2)

res={}
for name,lo,hi,c,g0,A0,o0 in [('G',1525,1645,1580.5,17.5,8300,5700),
                              ('2D',2565,2785,2670.3,37.0,12500,1000)]:
    m=(w>=lo)&(w<=hi); t=w[m]; yy=y[m]
    pf,cov=curve_fit(lor_lin,t,yy,p0=[c,g0,A0,o0,0],maxfev=300000)
    err=np.sqrt(np.diag(cov))
    r=yy-lor_lin(t,*pf)
    print(name,"n",m.sum())
    print("  x0=%.6f +/- %.4f"% (pf[0],err[0]))
    print("  gamma_FWHM=%.6f +/- %.4f"% (pf[1],err[1]))
    print("  amplitude=%.4f +/- %.4f"% (pf[2],err[2]))
    print("  offset=%.4f +/- %.4f"% (pf[3],err[3]))
    print("  slope=%.6f"% pf[4], "rmse=%.2f"%r.std())
    print("  raw x0 = 1e7/x0 =", 1e7/pf[0])
    res[name]={'x0':float(pf[0]),'gamma':float(pf[1]),'amplitude':float(pf[2]),'offset':float(pf[3])}
with open('/app/results.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(res,f,indent=2)
print(open('/app/results.json').read())
EOF
